crm_import_jobs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE crm_import_jobs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	organization_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_import_id INTEGER, 
	inbound_import_id INTEGER, 
	input_object_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	parameters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR, 
	lease_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error VARCHAR(200), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_target CHECK ((owner_import_id IS NOT NULL) <> (inbound_import_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_status CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'retry_wait', 'completed', 'failed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_crm_import_job_attempts CHECK (attempt_count >= 0 AND max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10), 
	UNIQUE (owner_import_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_import_id) REFERENCES crm_contact_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (inbound_import_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_import_id) REFERENCES crm_inbound_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (input_object_key)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_crm_import_jobs_claim ON crm_import_jobs (status, available_at, lease_expires_at)
